aviation_incidents.headline: 易捷航空A321neo飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速轉降 備用機接送乘客
aviation_incidents.summary: 易捷航空一架A321neo於2026年11月26日在愛丁堡發生飛行中引擎關閉事件；該機飛行兩分鐘後引擎失速，隨後轉降，仍停在愛丁堡地面。易捷航空派出備用機接送乘客前往目的地，航班延誤六小時。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: easyJet A321neo Diverts After Engine Stall Two Minutes Into Flight, Spare Jet Sent to Carry Passengers
aviation_incidents.summary_en: An easyJet A321neo experienced an in-flight engine shutdown in Edinburgh on Nov. 26, 2026. The engine stalled two minutes into the flight and the aircraft then diverted; it remained on the ground in Edinburgh. easyJet dispatched a spare jet to take passengers to their destination, and the flight was delayed six hours.

aviation_incidents.headline: 六起獨立航空事件包括接觸樹木、衝出或偏出跑道、引擎問題與雷擊
aviation_incidents.summary: 六起事件彼此獨立，沒有資料指出互相關聯。FAST Congo的L410於2026年11月27日在Dilolo進場時接觸樹木；Delta的空中巴士A321於2026年11月26日在亞特蘭大發生引擎故障。2026年11月25日，Fedex的MD-11在邁阿密降落時衝出跑道，Western Global的波音747-400於東京回滑時偏出跑道，France的波音777-300於巴黎附近出現引擎電子控制問題，THY的波音737-800於Batumi遭多次雷擊。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Six Independent Aviation Incidents Span Tree Contact, Runway Overruns and Excursions, Engine Problems, and Lightning Strikes
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The six incidents were independent, with no stated relationship. FAST Congo's L410 contacted trees on approach at Dilolo on Nov. 27, 2026; Delta's Airbus A321 had an engine failure in Atlanta on Nov. 26, 2026. On Nov. 25, 2026, Fedex's MD-11 overran the runway while landing at Miami, Western Global's Boeing 747-400 had a runway excursion while backtracking at Tokyo, France's Boeing 777-300 had an engine electronic-control problem near Paris, and THY's Boeing 737-800 experienced multiple lightning strikes at Batumi.

international_aviation.headline: NAV Canada慶祝航空導航服務30週年
international_aviation.summary: NAV Canada於1996年成立，現慶祝航空導航服務30週年。成立兩年後，該機構開發EXCDS電子飛航條系統，將航管人員原以手寫註記紙條管理的飛航資料數位化。2019年導入太空型自動相依監視廣播（ADS-B），改變海洋及偏遠空域的監視能力；自1996年以來，投入加拿大航空導航系統的金額已超過35億美元。
international_aviation.headline_en: NAV Canada Marks 30 Years of Air Navigation Services
international_aviation.summary_en: Established in 1996, NAV Canada is marking 30 years of air navigation services. Two years after its creation, it developed EXCDS, an electronic flight-strip system that digitized flight data air traffic controllers had managed on handwritten paper strips. Space-based automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast (ADS-B) was introduced in 2019, transforming surveillance over oceanic and remote airspace; more than US$3.5 billion has been invested in Canada's air navigation system since 1996.

international_aviation.headline: 波音B-47 Stratojet於1959年完成80小時36分鐘紀錄飛行
international_aviation.summary: 改裝波音B-47 Stratojet於1959年11月27日當地時間03:13自俄亥俄州Wright-Patterson Air Force Base起飛，連續飛行80小時36分鐘創下航空紀錄；飛機在美國多地反覆繞飛，並返回Dayton一帶空中加油。一架波音KC-135 Stratotanker在任務中提供燃油，進行10次空中加油。任務目標之一是評估一款改善飛行員長時間飛行舒適度的實驗型傾斜式彈射座椅。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing B-47 Stratojet Completes 80-Hour, 36-Minute Record Flight in 1959
international_aviation.summary_en: A modified Boeing B-47 Stratojet took off from Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio at 03:13 local time on Nov. 27, 1959, and remained airborne for 80 hours and 36 minutes, setting an aviation record. It flew repeated circuits across the United States and returned to the Dayton area for aerial refuelling. A Boeing KC-135 Stratotanker supplied fuel in 10 aerial refuelling operations; one mission objective was to evaluate an experimental tilting ejection seat intended to improve pilot comfort during extended missions.
